messages.subject: Adding a legend when tippoint and branches are colored
messages.subject_clean: Adding a legend when tippoint and branches are colored
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I'm having a problem when plotting my tree. The following code correctly plot the tree but the legend of the tippoint are missing and it's really bothering.

Is someone have the solution to be able by any mean to have a legend for the tippoint?

(I am using ggtree version 3.2.0)

Code:
```
library(ggimage)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(phytools)
library(ggtree)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(plyr)
library(treeio)
library(ggrepel)

# Tree
tree_file="./iqtree_terL_prot/all_terL.protein.treefile"

tree_nwk = read.iqtree(tree_file)

outgroup_leafs = c("AIS73870.1", "AUV59874.1", "ALY06847.1", "ATW59533.1", "AFU63088.1", "ANO57933.1", "AUV57347.1", "AVH85671.1")

annot_df = read_tsv(annot_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

tree_nwk = root(tree_nwk, outgroup=outgroup_leafs)

tiplabel_order <- tree_nwk@phylo$tip.label

# Reorder based on the tip label order in the tree
annot_df = annot_df[match(tiplabel_order, annot_df$Genes),]

# Genus at tippoint
p = ggtree(tree_nwk, ladderize = TRUE, size=2, aes(color=UFboot)) %<+%
annot_df +
scale_color_continuous(low='red', high='darkgreen') +
geom_tiplab(aes(label=phage_name), align = T, offset = 0.05, size=2.5, color="black") +
geom_tippoint(size=2, shape=21, stroke = 1.5, color=as.factor(annot_df$contrast), fill=as.factor(annot_df$color)) +
theme(legend.position="left") +
xlim_tree(8)

ggsave("./tree_ggtree_boot_subfamily.pdf", p, width = 10, height = 15,limitsize = FALSE)
```
I really need to find a way to have this legend to identify the clade

Best
Remi
